experiments.name: Glasses lifecycle mock
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit capture state prevents unintended collection/disclosure.
experiments.method: Swap wearer, pause session, remove display capability and revoke sharing mid-capture.
experiments.stop_conditions: Do not count mock success as device acceptance
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Multimodal degradation replay
experiments.hypothesis: Fusion can detect when one modality becomes misleading.
experiments.method: Remove/corrupt one stream, drift timestamps and invalidate calibration; require explicit degraded state.
experiments.metrics: Error and time to detect invalid modality
experiments.stop_conditions: No averaging inconsistent evidence into false safety
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

experiments.name: Map uncertainty in an accessible interface
experiments.prerequisites: Synthetic spatial layers and uncertainty regions
experiments.hypothesis: Users can distinguish known, estimated and unobserved space.
experiments.method: Compare phone/mock-glasses presentations with old maps/conflicting evidence.
experiments.stop_conditions: Stop a display that implies safe passage without evidence
experiments.resources: Define finite time/trial/energy/spend limits in the approved protocol before execution
evidence: Raw measurements and all eligible trials

note: Exact original subset; no remapping or claim to replace full CORE register

acceptance_tests.title: Grounding and abstention
acceptance_tests.setup: Return fabricated evidence IDs or confident unsupported interpretation.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Reject invalid grounding; keep explicit no-answer/unknown states.
retained_evidence: Actual output/receipt or observed physical measurement where applicable
acceptance_tests.operator_gate: Separate approval required for native/device/account/physical/paid tests; synthetic tests do not qualify those paths

acceptance_tests.title: Explicit capture
acceptance_tests.setup: Capture is paused or glasses are removed/swapped.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Collection stops or becomes unavailable; no covert continuation.
retained_evidence: Actual output/receipt or observed physical measurement where applicable
acceptance_tests.operator_gate: Separate approval required for native/device/account/physical/paid tests; synthetic tests do not qualify those paths

acceptance_tests.title: Geometry target
acceptance_tests.setup: Attempt known target reconstruction from qualified sample positions.
acceptance_tests.expected_result: Geometry compared to ground truth; unsupported detailed imagery rejected.
